recognize_zh: 高倍 LAP 染色：一群中性球紅色分葉核清楚，細胞質大多空白或只有極少藍點，僅一顆有較多藍色顆粒，屬於 0–1 分為主的低 LAP 分數。
features: Cluster of neutrophils with red-counterstained segmented nuclei
Most cells without or with very sparse blue granules (0 to 1+)
Single cell with more evident blue granules (about 2+)
Unstained red cells; slightly out-of-focus image
describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear shows a group of neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei. Most cells have no or only scattered faint blue granules (0 to 1+), with a single cell showing moderate positivity. The predominance of negative to weakly positive neutrophils corresponds to a low LAP score, as expected in chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: These typically show most neutrophils with moderate to strong granules and an elevated score.
Normal blood shows a mixture weighted toward 1+ to 2+ cells rather than a predominance of 0 cells.
